0022600030.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, 15th in the East) host the Toronto Raptors (4-4, 5th in the East) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, with Milwaukee entering on a four-game losing streak and a 1-3 home record. Toronto has lost its most recent game and is missing Immanuel Quickley (hamstring, out), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation, out), Nate Bittle (foot fracture, out), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness, out). Milwaukee's Kam Jones is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, and the teams have not met yet this season, though the Bucks lost 122-94 at home to Toronto on February 22, 2026, and the 2025-26 season series ended with the Bucks losing 1-3.
